rationale: The dossier proposes a consumer-grade note-taking integration (Obsidian) rather than a robust, low-latency persistent memory architecture suitable for high-frequency trading. It lacks any concrete code, API specifications, or architectural diagrams for the Warlord MCNC stack, relying instead on vague conceptual prompts.
suggestedAction: Replace Obsidian with a vector database (e.g., ChromaDB or Pinecone) integrated via Node.js/Express for persistent MQL5 strategy memory, and provide a concrete schema for volatility scanner state persistence.
